book.example: Ch. 7 Maneuvering Board Example 1 (p. 244): Closest point of approach
book.note: Ranges in yards (12000, 10700, 10000, 9000) converted at 2000 yd = 1 NM (the maneuvering board convention; the book's 4035 yd in 12 min = 10 kn uses it). Printed CPA 6900 yd = 3.45 NM. Own course and speed not given; set 000/0 (not needed). SPEC uses only the first and last plots.

Ch. 7 Maneuvering Board Example 6 (p. 254): Course and speed to pass another ship at a specified distance
book.note: Ranges 20000/16700 yd at 2000 yd/NM. Course changed 'when range is 13,000 yd' = 6.5 NM, which the book times at 1736 + 6.7 min; SPEC times are HH:MM so 17:43 is used (range then 6.42 NM). Explicit new course 212 at 12 kn; printed CPA 3000 yd = 1.5 NM, bearing 076, time 1811.

book.example: Ch. 7 Maneuvering Board Example 7 (p. 256): same as Example 6 in miles, relative plot as relative vector
book.note: Course changed when range is 6.5 NM (book: 1736 + 6.5 min; by the plot it is 1736 + 6.35). SPEC HH:MM gives 17:42 (range 6.6 NM). Book asks for the course at 12 kn to pass ahead with CPA 1.5 NM, turning right; mapped to find course, want 1.5 (smallest starboard alteration).
